## prompt-1-mermaid

*Generated by Process A (the bootstrap milestone) from the single master prompt in
[`../prompts/prompt-paper.md`](../prompts/prompt-paper.md), adapting the
`trial-protocol/sub-prompts/prompt-1-mermaid.md` conventions to the Phase 1
Pancreatic Cancer Trial Efficient LLM Document Generations paper (paper v1.0,
repository v4.2.0). Runs in stage `trial-documents/mermaid/`.*

Author the **Stage 1 Mermaid figure catalog** for the paper *Phase 1 Pancreatic
Cancer Trial Efficient LLM Document Generations* into `trial-documents/mermaid/`.

**Scope.** Produce **at least 20** new, comprehensive, professional Mermaid
diagrams, each in its own Markdown file (`fig-NN-slug.md`) that opens with a real
```mermaid``` fenced block so it renders natively on GitHub, followed by a short
caption, the figure's role in the paper, and the exact repository source files the
figure draws from (Rule 5). Every figure must be **new to this paper** - do not
re-use any prior author figure development from `trial-protocol/mermaid`,
`trial-phase-2/mermaid`, or elsewhere. All quantitative content (document counts,
review clocks, reporting windows, time buckets, iteration cadence) must be carried
from the author sources so each diagram is comprehensive, not decorative. There
must be no overlap between components in any figure.

**Color scheme (every figure, identical `classDef` block).**

```
classDef goal   fill:#8B2E3F,stroke:#000000,stroke-width:1.5px,color:#FFFFFF
classDef proc   fill:#2F5D7C,stroke:#000000,stroke-width:1.4px,color:#FFFFFF
classDef accent fill:#D08770,stroke:#000000,stroke-width:1.3px,color:#111111
classDef input  fill:#BFD7EA,stroke:#2F5D7C,stroke-width:1.2px,color:#111111
classDef ctx    fill:#F4F7F9,stroke:#6C757D,stroke-width:1.1px,color:#111111
classDef warn   fill:#D9D9D9,stroke:#000000,stroke-width:1.2px,color:#111111
```

Roles: `goal` (#8B2E3F deep maroon) for end goals, patient outcomes, and critical
decisions; `proc` (#2F5D7C steel blue) for LLM, system, and process nodes;
`accent` (#D08770 terracotta) for acceleration and time-savings emphasis; `input`
(#BFD7EA light blue) for inputs and source files; `ctx` (#F4F7F9 near-white) for
context and supporting nodes; `warn` (#D9D9D9 gray) for gates and decision
diamonds. White text on the maroon and steel-blue fills, dark text on the light
fills. This same five-step palette becomes the TikZ `mm*` node styles in the LaTeX
stages, so emphasis must read by fill and stroke weight alone, and the LaTeX
figures must look the same as the Python Mermaid figures.

**Required figures (24; each comprehensive).**
1. `fig-01-single-prompt-pipeline` - the single-prompt mermaid -> draft -> full ->
   final build pipeline for this paper.
2. `fig-02-subprompt-schedule` - Process A (generate sub-prompts) and Process B
   (execute sub-prompts sequentially under one master prompt).
3. `fig-03-phase1-document-landscape` - the large Phase 1 oncology document map
   (IND, IRB package, IB, ICF, protocol, DSUR, SAE/SUSAR narratives, amendments,
   cohort-review packages, clinical-hold response, CSR, briefing book).
4. `fig-04-acceleration-targets` - the six greatest-acceleration document targets,
   ranked by schedule value (ACCELERATION list).
5. `fig-05-document-gate-taxonomy` - hard gate / protocol-defined gate / decision
   gate and which documents fall under each.
6. `fig-06-data-collection-pipeline` - before / during / after data collection
   (EHR -> EDC -> eCRF -> eCOA/ePRO -> AE logs -> SDV -> database lock).
7. `fig-07-pretrial-authoring` - PI plus medical-writer pre-trial document
   authoring (IND, protocol, IB, ICF) through an eDMS.
8. `fig-08-intratrial-authoring` - during-trial documents (SAE/SUSAR 7/15-day,
   DSUR, protocol amendments, dose-escalation meeting minutes).
9. `fig-09-posttrial-authoring` - after-trial documents (database lock, TLFs, CSR,
   manuscripts, lay summaries).
10. `fig-10-iteration-timeline` - the new 1-4 day document iteration cadence
    versus the traditional weeks-to-months baseline.
11. `fig-11-time-bucket-compression` - the three timeline buckets (clinical/
    operational, administrative/prep, regulatory review); only admin/prep
    compresses.
12. `fig-12-repo-llm-architecture` - the repository-based LLM architecture
    (inputs -> context -> sub-prompts -> sectioned outputs).
13. `fig-13-autocommit-monitorability` - the real-time auto-commit / auto-PR
    monitorability loop (generate -> commit -> push -> PR -> human review).
14. `fig-14-grounding-mermaid-to-tikz` - grounding via Mermaid figures reproduced
    as identical TikZ in LaTeX.
15. `fig-15-name-matching-verification` - the five verification checks that paper
    repository, directory, and file names match the repository.
16. `fig-16-benefit-risk-framework` - probable benefit greater than probable risk
    for faster document administration.
17. `fig-17-patient-time-saved-cascade` - faster paperwork -> faster treatment ->
    extended PFS/OS.
18. `fig-18-paper-section-architecture` - the paper sections (Abstract through Back
    Matter) mapped to the corresponding `sections/*.tex` files.
19. `fig-19-five-color-palette` - the five-color palette and the Mermaid-to-TikZ
    figure-fidelity scheme.
20. `fig-20-quality-verification-gates` - document quality gates that avoid
    amendments, regulator questions, IRB revisions, and extra review cycles.
21. `fig-21-daraxonrasib-document-thread` - the real-world daraxonrasib PDAC trial
    document thread (Phase 1 protocol -> amendments -> cohort review -> Phase 2
    briefing).
22. `fig-22-author-trust-timeline` - the author LLM-trust evidence timeline
    (Aug 2024 - Jun 2026) leading to this single-prompt project.
23. `fig-23-ind-irb-initial-package` - the composition of the initial IND and IRB
    package (acceleration target #1).
24. `fig-24-clinical-hold-response` - the complete clinical-hold response and its
    30-day FDA review clock (acceleration target #4).

**Commit schedule (Rules 6, 7, 8).** One commit per figure file, pushed in real
time (24 commits). The second-to-last commit fixes all errors across every figure
file. The last commit writes `trial-documents/mermaid/README.md` (badges,
structure, the colored build Mermaid, and a figure inventory table naming each
source file) and `output-mermaid.md` (narrative output under an `## output-mermaid`
heading). Do not stall, ask questions, or go into plan mode.
